name: The Breach of Córdoba
description: Southern Spain, 1914. The Battle of Córdoba (1910) left the ancient city in ruins. The Heretics hold Gibraltar and push north through the Guadalquivir valley.
lore: The Heretics hold Gibraltar and push north through the Guadalquivir valley. The Faithful defend from Castille through the Sierra Morena passes. Three years of trench warfare have turned Andalucía into a blasted wasteland.
